aboutBody: LP/EP Finder is a free search engine for vinyl records sold by independent record shops. It started more than ten years ago, and was called Vinyl Finder for a while.

Every week our crawler, LPEPFinderBot, reads the public product catalogs of record shops, keeps the records in stock, and builds a search index. We link to the shop for every record; we don't sell anything and don't copy product descriptions or images.
Shop owners: your shop is listed for free. To be removed, block LPEPFinderBot in robots.txt or contact us; to be added, use the form on the “Add a shop” page.
aboutData: Shop list from the LP/EP Finder community, Discogs record store listings and OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Product data from each shop's public catalog.
submitBody: Any shop with an online store selling records can be listed. Shops on Shopify or WooCommerce get their full catalog searchable; others are listed with a link.
submitEmail: Or email us the shop's website:
statusBody: Every shop is checked weekly: is the site up, does robots.txt allow us, does it still sell records, can we read its catalog.
footerNote: Prices and stock come from each shop and can change. Links go to the shops.

privacyBody: LP/EP Finder does not ask for an account and does not store personal data on its servers. Searches run in your browser.

Advertising: this site shows ads from Google AdSense. Google and its partners use cookies to show ads based on your visits to this and other websites. You can turn off personalised ads in Google's Ads Settings (adssettings.google.com). Visitors in the European Economic Area, the UK and Switzerland are asked for consent first.
Analytics: we count visits with Umami, which uses no cookies and collects no personal data. The statistics are public.
Links to record shops take you to their websites, which have their own privacy policies.
Questions: write to the contact address on the About page.
emptyFewerWords: Try fewer or shorter words, or the artist name alone.
